name: LPI Linux Essentials

D1.name: The Linux operating system and open source software

realExamNote: The real exam has 40 multiple-choice and fill-in-the-blank questions in 60 minutes. This course follows the version 2.0 objectives (exam 010-200), released October 15, 2026. Version 1.6 (010-160) stays available for six months after that, and most topics overlap.
scoreNote: LPI reports a scaled score from 200 to 800 with 500 to pass; the timed mock exam maps percent correct onto that scale, so treat 500+ as a readiness signal, not a guarantee.
